title: Cortex v1 vs Qwen3-8B-Base — continued evaluation
note: Time-budgeted coverage of all requested categories, not all official full test splits. Seeded up to 50 examples per standard leaf task; 1,280 bilingual synthetic domain cases per model; 120 paired context cases per model plus 40 Cortex-only 64K cases. Standard tasks use matched completion; deployment fixtures use Cortex native chat vs Base plain transcript with identical demonstrations, schema and 128-token cap. Synthetic cases are parameter-held-out, not independently authored. No overall winner. The original runtime budget was reached; the user authorized continuation to finish remaining work without a new hard stop. Completed work remains preserved.
